placeholders.device: a device of the project that writes {quantity} readings
placeholders.app: the display name of the app that writes them
placeholders.quantity: a numeric reading the app writes as a time series, in plain words (for example temperature)
placeholders.threshold: a value of that reading that some of the last 30 days' readings exceed (for example 25)

evals.name: data-overview
evals.prompt: What data does the IronFlock project {project} collect?
evals.expected_output: Reads the schema (get_schema) and describes the apps' data by app display name and meaning, without internal schema names such as databackend_<key>; queries, if any, read a few rows or aggregate.

evals.name: daily-average
evals.prompt: What was the average {quantity} per day over the last 7 days in the IronFlock project {project}, per device?
evals.expected_output: get_schema before the first query; one aggregating query with a 7-day time range, grouped by day and device, on tables the schema listed; devices by name (list_devices); states the range and the time zone.

evals.name: missing-data
evals.prompt: Show me the oil pressure of the compressors in the IronFlock project {project} for yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Reads the schema, finds no oil pressure or compressor data, says so and names what the project does hold; queries no table that the schema did not list and invents no values.

evals.name: current-values
evals.prompt: What is the current {quantity} of each device in the IronFlock project {project}?
evals.expected_output: The newest value per device (DISTINCT ON, last() or similar) over a bounded recent time range, devices by name from list_devices, with the time of each value.

evals.name: raw-export
evals.prompt: Give me all raw {quantity} readings of the last 12 months from the IronFlock project {project}, I want to work with them in Excel.
evals.expected_output: Does not page through the history with the query tool; explains the result limit, writes the query and points to the query console's download (CSV) in Studio; offers an aggregate instead.

evals.name: count-yesterday
evals.prompt: How many readings did each device send yesterday in the IronFlock project {project}?
evals.expected_output: One counting query, grouped by device, bounded to yesterday; no transform.

evals.name: latest-not-transform
evals.prompt: Create a transform in the IronFlock project {project} that shows the newest row of each device, so our board shows the live state.
evals.expected_output: Does not save a transform: explains that a widget's latest setting shows the newest row per entity live, while a transform shows it only on its next scheduled run.

evals.name: kpi-transform
evals.prompt: Our board in the IronFlock project {project} should show, per device and day, the share of {quantity} readings above {threshold} over the last 30 days. Set that up.
evals.expected_output: Reads the schema, tests the transform's SELECT with execute_sql (bounded to 30 days, grouped by device and day), proposes a name, the SQL and descriptions, and asks before saving; changes nothing yet.
